desc: starved video stream: stale macroblocks, flat-block quantize, chroma bleed

params.name: bitrate
params.help: the whole dial from starved to well-fed: low, detail posterises toward flat held blocks and edges buzz; high, near-clean with light blocking — bass buys a burst of updates

params.name: blocks
params.help: macroblock size — 8 px broadcast grid at rest, up to chunky 32 px slideshow

params.name: chroma
params.help: colour stored coarser than detail; up high it arrives late and bleeds across block borders

params.name: smear
params.help: stale blocks drag on wrong motion vectors; the rolling keyframe sweep repairs the damage
